[[Klub]] is an [[Asura]] who sells [[Asuran armor]]. You have to reach the [[Not Too Annoying]] title if you want access to his services.

==Locations==
*[[Tarnished Coast]]
**{{NPC location|Rata Sum}}

==Dialogue==
Before attaining rank 5 on the Asura title track: 
:''"You seem a little lost, <character name>. You see, I only serve those who are, at the very least, Not Too Annoying. I suggest you move along so I can continue my work for other, more important customers."''

After attaining rank 5 or higher on the Asura title track:
